title: GBPUSD M30 ATR Volatility Filter to Eliminate 2026 Regime Chop
research_question: Does enabling the ATR volatility filter (InpUseAtrFilter=true, InpMaxAtrPips=20.0) on GBPUSD M30 filter out high-volatility false breakouts during the 2026 UNSEEN partition, reducing trade losses and shifting profit factor from 0.62 to >= 1.20 with drawdown <= 6.0%?
hypothesis: Enabling InpUseAtrFilter=true with InpMaxAtrPips=20.0 while maintaining baseline 15-pip TP1 will block entries during erratic volatility spikes, filtering out the false Fibonacci breakout losses observed in the 2026 UNSEEN partition and reducing maximal drawdown below 6.0%.

facts: EXP-0048 (2026 UNSEEN) recorded 16 losing trades out of 34 trades, resulting in -$592.46 net loss, PF 0.62, and 11.17% maximal drawdown.

EXP-0051 demonstrated that expanding TP1 to 22.0 pips was ineffective (win rate crashed to 18.75%), proving that the 2026 failure is caused by false entries during low-momentum chop rather than exit target sizing.
Fibonacci_EA_v5_0 contains a built-in ATR filter (InpUseAtrFilter) which was previously tested successfully on USDJPY (EXP-0046, +$566.28).
inferences: During 2026, many Fibonacci retracement entries occurred during volatility spikes or erratic sessions that lacked trend continuation, leading to quick stop-outs.
Enabling InpUseAtrFilter with a 20-pip ceiling will suppress trade execution during erratic spikes, filtering out false signals while preserving high-conviction continuation entries.

independent_variables.name: InpUseAtrFilter
independent_variables.rationale: Enables the built-in ATR volatility guard to skip entries during volatility spikes.

independent_variables.name: InpMaxAtrPips
independent_variables.rationale: Sets the maximum ATR(14) entry ceiling to 20 pips, filtering out entries when market noise is excessive.

assumptions: GBPUSD M30 average ATR(14) in normal market conditions is between 10 and 18 pips.
Spikes exceeding 20 pips correlate with news announcements or erratic false breakouts.
expected_observations: Total losing trades decrease relative to baseline.
Training net profit remains positive (> $500.00) with profit factor >= 2.0.
2026 UNSEEN net profit improves from -$592.46 toward breakeven or positive.
falsification_conditions: Total trades drop below 5 across the 5-year training period (over-filtering).
Profit factor remains < 1.0 in 2026 UNSEEN benchmark.
